messages:
Omar (sales): Heads-up: Pegasus deal POC next Wed. They want a 48h smoke + throughput validation and a clean handoff doc for reserved GPUs, autoscale, and security Qs.
Jules (solutions): Quick profile needed: burst qps, steady qps, token sizes, sync vs async?
Omar (sales): Baseline ~70 qps, short bursts up to ~260 qps (1-6m). Typical output ~120 tokens. Mostly sync chat/generation, little embeddings.
Jules (solutions): Ballpark: redwood-14b-v1 -> ~0.8-1.0s p50 for 120 tokens on 48GB class. Suggest reserved 6 GPUs + burst credits, autoscale to 12 for sustained surges.
Nina (infra): Proposed autoscale policy: min_reserved=6, max_reserved=12, scale_step=1 GPU / 30s, triggers: queued_requests + p95_latency. Burst-credit window: 180s before autoscale.
Marco (sre): Prefer burst credits for <3m spikes to avoid cold starts. Will add eviction/spot fallback table to handoff.
Priya (security): For the questionnaire: Dedicated supports VPC peering or private deployment, customer-managed KMS, SOC2 Type II, console IP allowlist, and SSO. Send the PDF and Ill draft formal answers.
Omar (sales): Posted: https://pegasus.example.com/sec-qa.pdf Also they want admin console access controls documented.
Priya (security): We can provide IP allowlist, org-level SSO, and stricter session timeouts. Draft due EOD tomorrow.
Jules (solutions): Preheat runbook (short):
1) deploy canary model variant to reserved pool
2) seed top-60 prompts into KV cache
3) run warmer at 10 qps for 12m
4) validate kv_cache_hit_rate >= 60% and p95 latency targets
5) if p95 > target -> add 1 GPU
Marco (sre): OpsBot: schedule poc_smoke_pegasus for Wed 09:00 PT (canary + 48h validation).
OpsBot: Scheduled poc_smoke_pegasus for 2026-04-08T16:00:00Z. Report will be posted in this thread. :robot_face: 
Omar (sales): Can someone paste an autoscale JSON to hand to their infra team?
Nina (infra): Handoff JSON: {"autoscale": {"min_reserved": 6, "max_reserved": 12, "scale_step_secs": 30, "burst_credit_threshold_secs": 180, "metrics": ["queued_requests", "p95_latency"]}}
Jules (solutions): Pricing note: if they commit to quantized variant (q8) we usually see ~+25-30% throughput; propose a reserved-commit discount on unit price (well include sensitivity table). If they want 100% quant, call out possible +1-2 GPU need to meet tail SLOs.
Marco (sre): Ill add SLA notes and an eviction tolerance table to the final deliverable.
Omar (sales): Great, thanks team. Priya ping me when the security draft is ready and Ill loop legal. :thumbsup:
